game_concept: A action defense set in The Kingdom – Castle Gatehouse, the fortified castle gatehouse: the knight must handle goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Score Keeper: Update score, lives and ammo variables after every event while goblin raiders close in.
theme: The Kingdom – Castle Gatehouse: the fortified castle gatehouse
core_gameplay_loop: In Castle Gatehouse, repeat each round: Update score, lives and ammo variables after every event while goblin raiders close in. Each round, goblin raiders strike the royal vault, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the score value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the royal vault from goblin raiders in Castle Gatehouse: keep the score meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 29-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: score drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 29-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 3 (intro tier): Score Keeper
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Score Keeper' (Week 1 slot 6), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Castle Gatehouse'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against goblin raiders in Castle Gatehouse.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 29 seconds while score > 0.
